§6Smoker Block§f

§aSmoke on demand. No fireplace required.§f
The §bSmoker§f generates smoke independently without needing a furnace or heat source underneath. Right-click it to open the GUI and tweak everything: particle amount (up to §e16§f), blow-out intensity (up to §e4 blocks§f), particle scale, and color.

The color picker uses ARGB hex values. The alpha channel controls tint probability: §eFF§f = always tinted, §e7F§f = 50% chance, §e00§f = never. You can also toggle whether it emits smoke from adjacent chimneys and whether it needs a redstone signal.

§9Note:§f Smoke still collides with obstacles and flows around walls. It has a §e10% chance§f of being tinted by any chimney material it passes through.

§ePS:§f Great for atmospheric effects in bases or as visual indicators when machines are running.
